meta_title: WebP to PNG Converter: Keep Transparency | Resize-It
meta_description: Convert WebP to PNG and keep transparent backgrounds. Lossless PNG output for editing. Batch convert in your browser with no uploads.
subtitle: Convert WebP images to PNG to edit them anywhere and keep transparent backgrounds. One file or a whole batch, processed on your own device.

tool_workspace.description: Drop one or more WebP files below, then click Convert Image.
features_list: Runs in your browser: no uploads

requirements.intro: PNG is supported by every editor and keeps transparency, so it is the safest format to convert a WebP into when you plan to edit it or need a transparent background.

rows.label: Compression
rows.value: WebP: Lossy or lossless (this tool saves lossy WebP at 90% quality). PNG: Lossless: pixels are stored exactly.

rows.label: Transparency
rows.value: WebP: Yes, including in lossy mode. PNG: Yes, full transparency.

rows.label: Best for
rows.value: WebP: Images on websites, where smaller files load faster. PNG: Screenshots, logos, graphics with text or sharp edges, images that need a transparent background.

rows.label: Compatibility
rows.value: WebP: All current browsers. Some older desktop software and some upload forms still reject WebP. PNG: Opens everywhere.

requirements.notes_h3: Before you convert WebP to PNG
notes: Transparency is kept: transparent areas in the WebP stay transparent in the PNG.
The PNG is usually larger than the WebP, because PNG is lossless.
Converting does not restore detail lost when the WebP was created, but further edits will not reduce quality.
Animated WebP files are converted as a single still image (the first frame).

how_to.title: How to convert WebP to PNG
how_to.step1_text: Select or drag in one or more WebP files. They are read in your browser, not uploaded.
how_to.step2_text: PNG is already selected on this page. You can switch to another format if needed.
how_to.step3_text: Click Convert Image. Each image is redrawn and saved in the new format on your device.
how_to.step4_text: A single image downloads directly; several images download together as a ZIP.

items.q: Does WebP to PNG keep transparency?

items.a: PNG stores every pixel exactly, while WebP usually uses compression. The bigger file is normal.
Yes. Select several files and download a ZIP.
No. Everything is processed in your browser.
